content.text: Varargs allow a method to accept zero or more arguments of a specified type without explicitly creating an array.

items: Internally, Java treats varargs as an array.
Only one varargs parameter is allowed per method.
If there are multiple parameters, varargs must be the last one.
A varargs method is preferred over multiple overloaded methods.
